description: Divisional Secretary Kamburupitiya - Annual Asela Maha Perehara of Sapugoda Ilangamgoda purana Raja Maha Vihara of  Kamburupitiya  Matara District will be held from 06.07.2017 to 13.07.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the dates for the Kamburupitiya Sapugoda Annual Asala Maha Perahara, a religious/cultural festival. It is published under the Pilgrimage Ordinance, but the content itself is an announcement of an event schedule, not a change to the legal framework. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any of the specialized administrative categories (Types 4-9). Therefore, it falls under Miscellaneous for cultural/event announcements.
